The energy balance calculator successfully passed all validation tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust implementation of weighted calculations.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. The system successfully processed the weighted-campus-energy-balance-calc task, confirming that the core logic for energy risk assessment is functional. Future iterations should ensure that edge cases in weighting factors are handled, as the current success relies on the specific trial parameters provided in the initial run.
